materials.page_background: Layered dark glass with restrained amber/red light fields; no fake dashboard decoration.
materials.brand_header: Official Halo Fire mark plus compact client-access text; no internal alpha or invite-only wording.
materials.login_panel: Translucent glass, blur/saturation, inner highlight, soft stroke, deep shadow, readable contrast.
materials.inputs: Inset glass wells with hover border, focus ring, highlight, stable height, and no browser-default flat treatment.
materials.button: Dimensional amber glass button with top sheen, inset edge highlight, hover lift, pressed state, and focus-visible ring.
materials.checkbox: Native checkbox retained with fire accent and clean spacing because no complex custom control is needed.
materials.hero: Unframed Three.js canvas with extruded flame mesh, one halo ring, ember sprites, hover/click/drag states, and hidden non-draggable fallback logo.

reject_if: Visible card border around hero scene
Hero becomes a pasted image or texture rectangle
